rationale: With only 8 minutes remaining in the session and mandatory liquidation at the close, the $0.04 bid-ask spread (13.4 bps) consumes more than half of the 5-minute ATR ($0.0760). Despite strong intraday buyer absorption that has pushed price to 98.9% of its daily range on 3.14x relative volume against a weak broad market, there is insufficient time and range expansion left to overcome the immediate spread cost for a long, and no structural breakdown to justify a short.
